_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Never put API keys in this repository. Keys are entered in TrueForge (Settings -> Models, http://localhost:8790) and stored in TrueForge's local SQLite database. AXIOM Forge itself never sees or sends them.

providers.how: TrueForge Settings -> Models -> Google Gemini -> paste a Gemini API key (free tier from Google AI Studio)
providers.note: Model ids come from TrueForge's shipped catalog (GET /api/v1/catalogs/model-providers). Use the full name TrueForge lists under GET /api/v1/models.

providers.how: TrueForge Settings -> Models -> Add custom provider (OpenAI-compatible)
exampleModelIds: <a Groq model id that supports tool calling; check Groq's current model list>

vscodeSettings.axiomForge.models.primary: <primary model name exactly as GET /api/v1/models lists it>
vscodeSettings.axiomForge.models.backup: <backup model name exactly as GET /api/v1/models lists it>
